title: Required-empty inline validation messages for employer_name still say "employer's name", re-introducing the sole-trader incoherence on the error path
evidence:
|> require_non_empty(
        values,
        "employer_name",
        "Your employer\u{2019}s name, please.",
      )
... (co-applicant branch, line ~797)
      |> require_non_empty(
        values,
        co_applicant_field_key(index, "employer_name"),
        "Their employer\u{2019}s name.",
      )
detail: The relabeled fields ("Employer / business name" work_income.gleam:100, "Their employer / business name" situation.gleam:348) render these messages when required-but-empty. A self-employed applicant who blanks the field is re-asked for "Your employer's name" — the framing the ruling removed. Spec's I/O matrix pins only the error-summary label; not in deferred-work ledger.
recommended_fix: Reword the two messages to match the ruling, e.g. "Your employer or business name, please." / "Their employer or business name.", or record the split in deferred-work.md.
